_why: PREPARATION, the gating case. A wizard prepares int_mod + character_level spells; int_mod is forced to -2 so the cap falls to its floor of 1, below the four spells in the book. The Dev Hub takes a long rest before every test fight (restore_class_resources -> prepare_auto_fill), which empties an overfull head and packs it again to the cap. Expect prepared_max 1, prepared_count 1, exactly one known_ true among the four held spells, and known_fire_bolt STILL true because cantrips are never gated.
